name: recovery-guardian
description: Recovery controller with direct covered E1 repair, observable ambiguous-write reconciliation, bounded liveness, append-only anti-loop evidence when needed, and standing-authority preservation.

interface.shortDescription: Recovers interrupted project workflows and prevents duplicate retries.
interface.longDescription: Use Recovery Guardian after a failed, interrupted, looping, or ambiguous Project Leader execution. It reconstructs durable state from GitHub, verifies whether writes already happened before retrying, breaks no-progress loops, preserves existing standing authority, and returns consequential next actions to Supervisor without creating routine Owner-permission prompts.
